title: Rebuilding Food Production
summary: Bunker grow-rooms can feed a vault, not a civilization. The survivors must learn to farm a damaged surface: recovering seed, fighting blight, and surviving lean years. Success unlocks growth; failure means famine.

beats.title: Blight
beats.description: Monoculture grow-racks are fragile; a single pathogen can wipe out a harvest.

beats.title: First surface harvest
beats.description: A surface settlement brings in its first real harvest.

beats.title: The seed vault
beats.description: Scouts find a pre-collapse seed bank; its contents could transform agriculture.

beats.title: The hungry years
beats.description: If all else fails, famine forces desperate choices.

possibleOutcomes: Heirloom seeds and hydroponics end chronic hunger.
Surface farms make the settlements self-sufficient and the bunker becomes a museum.
Recurring famine keeps the population small and fearful.
